label: See your calendar
description: Events, private ones included, and who is in the calendar.

label: Add events
description: Add an event everyone in the calendar sees, or a private one only you see.

label: Change events
description: Move or edit an event. Editing a private event can make it shared.

label: Delete events
description: Removes the event, for everyone when it is shared.

label: Set your display name
description: The name others see on your events.
